text: Healthy Non-Chinese citizen Under the age of 45 Bachelor's Degree Holder or above,or equivalent English Proficiency: TOEFL or IELTS minimum requirements is 550 points or above for TOEFL, and a grade 6.0 or above for IELTS, or other certificate of English proficiency from an approved test. Native English speakers are exempt from this requirement;other candidates whose University courses are taught in English will be considered case by case. Professional Backgrounds: Applicants with relevant professional experience or other qualifications deemed appropriciate to the programme applied for may also be considered.
